recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not add Evidence or information to Group unless a future work-group decision reopens that modeling question; related Group member-type decisions already have their own reconciliation commits.
issue_request: FHIR-24848 was Published/Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested adding an information Group.type code and Evidence as a Group.member.entity target for meta-analysis use cases; the accepted decision rejected that expansion and instead aligned Group around participant-type members while directing other collection use cases toward List.
initial_application: Commit 272e3fb71ecb0d87630a48101b00015f0f18b038, referenced from PR #2358, applied J#24848 by changing the active Group CodeSystem and StructureDefinition. It added participant-like Group types and member targets such as CareTeam, HealthcareService, Location, Organization, RelatedPerson, and Specimen, removed then-present non-participant entries, and did not add information or Evidence.
additional_context: The 2019 Zulip discussion and FHIR-I minutes confirm the scope-creep rationale and 7-0-0 vote. Later issues refined the same Group member-type area without reversing the seed: FHIR-26648 Organization, FHIR-35972 Specimen, FHIR-32318 BodyStructure, FHIR-49851 boundary/type guidance, and FHIR-52918 medication/substance definitional resources are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because active current Group source has no information group-type concept and no Evidence targetProfile, while the current allowed member list is explained by later applied or published decisions.
